placements.why: The team conducted further evaluation of Zypherion and discovered critical gaps in streaming ingestion, prompting an architectural revision to adopt Meridian instead for its native batch and streaming capabilities while preserving the Q3 2026 migration window.
placements.title: Adopting Meridian for Unified Batch and Streaming Analytics
placements.frame: Why is the organization switching to Meridian for analytics, and how does native batch and streaming capability satisfy ingestion requirements?
